description: Development safeguards and verification for Orchestrator Harness.

hooks.command: r="$PWD"; while [ "$r" != / ] && [ ! -f "$r/.codex/scripts/hook_runner.py" ]; do r=$(dirname "$r"); done; [ -f "$r/.codex/scripts/hook_runner.py" ] || { echo 'Unable to locate project hook runner' >&2; exit 1; }; uv run --project "$r/.codex/dev" --locked python "$r/.codex/scripts/hook_runner.py" session-start
hooks.commandWindows: $payload=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $j=$null; try { $j=$payload | ConvertFrom-Json } catch {}; $starts=@($j.cwd,$j.tool_input.workdir,$env:CODEX_PROJECT_ROOT,$env:CODEX_WORKSPACE_ROOT,$env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR,(Get-Location).Path); $r=$null; foreach ($s in $starts) { if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$s)) { continue }; try { $c=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath([string]$s) } catch { continue }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c -PathType Leaf) { $c=Split-Path -Parent $c }; while ($c) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $c '.codex/scripts/hook_runner.py')) { $r=$c; break }; $p=Split-Path -Parent $c; if ($p -eq $c) { break }; $c=$p }; if ($r) { break } }; if (-not $r) { Write-Error 'Unable to locate project hook runner from hook cwd, environment, or process directory'; exit 1 }; $payload | uv run --project (Join-Path $r '.codex/dev') --locked python (Join-Path $r '.codex/scripts/hook_runner.py') session-start; exit $LASTEXITCODE
